proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the network delay (e.g. a tc/netem qdisc or chaos injection) on the emailservice pod or its network path, then confirm caller-observed latency returns to baseline. Make checkout's email sending asynchronous or tightly time-limited so email latency cannot block checkout.
